verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Agent API's profiles: reusable, versioned configurations you save and manage. That is a form of persistent configuration, but the evidence does not say profiles hold custom instructions or preferences, nor that they apply to every response. Library and in-thread conversation context are not persistent instructions, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: evidence that profiles or app settings hold custom instructions/preferences, consumer-app (Pro/mobile/web) custom-instruction or memory settings, confirmation the configuration shapes every response, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response

citations.quote: A profile is a reusable, versioned configuration that you save and manage.
